status: experimental, theory-led and uncalibrated; not a universal enjoyment verdict
formula: 100*mean_windows(core_content_gate * saturated_recurrence_support * (0.25+0.75*confirmed_variant_support) * entropy_preference); mean across window scales
variant_support: requires >=2 exact copies per changed signature, >=.6 coverage both ways, same phase; variant strength is multiplied by its own recurrence support before family pooling; exact transposition gets .25; at least one side must contain >=2 residual points, so an isolated one-note substitution is retained as a match but not promoted to evolution credit
period_policy: Periodicity is descriptive. Only fixed-grid phase-walk-confounded variant evidence is discounted: fit above .90 and detected period not divisible by window width. Aligned repeated A/A-prime statements retain variant credit.
ablation: also emit same score without entropy preference
assumptions: 24 nominal tracker ticks per conventional beat
core summaries describe written point sets, not a recovered perceptual melody
no culture-universal optimal entropy or binary pleasantness claim
